title: oenothera villosa subsp. cheradophila
intro: Oenothera villosa subsp. cheradophila, commonly known as the Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant native to North America, belonging to the Onagraceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve skin health, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera villosa subsp. cheradophila include its sedative, antispasmodic, and emollient properties, making it useful in treating anxiety, muscle spasms, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an omega-6 fatty acid that plays a crucial role in its medicinal properties.
